title: NLLB-200
objective: Deliver ONE reusable NLLB-200 TTNN source that serves the distilled 600M, distilled 1.3B and 3.3B checkpoints from one configuration-driven backend, packaged in tt-metal style (tt/, demo/, reference/, tests/, benchmarks/, docs/ with SPDX headers) for an upstream tt-metal PR. Use 600M as the development anchor. Establish measured baselines first, pass smoke then bringup against the FP32 oracle, optimize against the recorded baseline with matched same-precision comparisons, then freeze for full validation.
